ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from creating new DisputeItem records if Account Name / Transaction IDs are missing
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Disputed_Transaction", OR( ISBLANK(TRIM( AccountDetails__c )), ISBLANK(TRIM( TransactionIdentifier ))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account Details and/or TransactionID are required. You are not allowed to add this transaction.
